content.text:
"We have a choice": AI leaders sound alarm at UN: Axios reported that AI executives called for global cooperation and safeguards at the UN Security Council. It also noted Trump had vowed not to hamstring AI development, placing his next-day status-quo statement against an already public policy contrast. (time=2026-09-23T20:50:26Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
US, China must ensure AI develops under 'human control:' Xi: AFP reported Xi saying the two countries had a responsibility to develop and manage AI for good; its headline characterized his position as keeping AI under human control. The report described AI as an agenda item for his meeting with Trump, not as a concluded agreement against new rules. (time=2026-09-24T16:52:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
